Post-amend evidence: immutable-prose-only PASS for all 13 paths; exact-leaf-paths PASS; comment-hygiene PASS; focused consumers 12/12 PASS; diff-integrity PASS; pre-commit Ruff and full mypy PASS; verify-commit-ticket PASS. Because the coordinator authored this correction after finding it, a different agent must perform the fresh 52-row non-author semantic review before push.
